site.title: Earth Systems Arcade
site.byline: Free geoscience apps and games by Dougalien Systems

collections.title: Earth Systems Arcade
collections.blurb: Geoscience apps and games for the classroom.

collections.title: More Apps
collections.blurb: Apps for history, civics, society and big questions in science.

tools.name: Lithonaut
tools.summary: A 3D rock cycle game. Visit field sites, take hand samples, and identify igneous, sedimentary and metamorphic rocks.

tools.name: Solar System Adventure
tools.summary: Fly with PEBBLES, the ship computer, to 21 worlds and judge whether each one has the ingredients for life.

tools.name: 3D Structural Geology Explorer
tools.summary: Squeeze a layer cake into thrusts and folds, stretch it with normal faults, add plutons, dikes and sills, then slide the land surface through it and click the map to see why the outcrop pattern looks the way it does.

tools.name: The Rock Cycle
tools.summary: Explore how rocks change from one type to another, with a gallery of real lab samples.

tools.name: Quake
tools.summary: Explore recent earthquakes from USGS data with a guided earthquake science mentor.

tools.name: River Explorer
tools.summary: Type a river, a town or a storm you remember. Find the real USGS stream gage and read its hydrograph.

tools.name: Resource Horizon
tools.summary: Will a resource last 100 years? Compare flat, steady and compounding use, with a source for every number.

tools.name: Hydrotherm
tools.summary: Compare data center cooling water with climate-driven evapotranspiration, with every number checkable by hand.

tools.name: TraceCode
tools.summary: Analyze x-y lab signals from GC, XRD and SEM/EDS: baselines, smoothing, peaks and FFT.

tools.name: Spectrum Earth
tools.summary: Landform and shape analysis from elevation profiles: valley cross-sections, river long profiles and volcano shapes.

tools.name: Paleo Diet Cruncher
tools.summary: Map and compare the diets of 5,831 living and extinct mammals, from mammoths to cave bears, and read carbon and nitrogen isotopes from fossil bone.

tools.name: The Perfect Society
tools.summary: Answer 20 questions about how people should live together, then see which of 21 great political thinkers would recognize your society as their own.

tools.name: Constitution Explorer
tools.summary: Ask questions in your own words and read the U.S. Constitution, landmark Supreme Court cases and the big debates, with primary sources for every answer.

tools.name: Finite Deformable Geometry
tools.summary: A web book, plain-language guide and interactive model exploring a finite, deformable universe: redshift, gravity, shape and boundary transitions.

tools.name: The Care Gap
tools.summary: See how many people aged 45 to 64 there are for each person aged 80 and over, in the nation or any state, and test ways to close the care gap.
